s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of unilateral facial and limb weakness with impaired motor function
salient_findings: Incomplete closure of the right eye
Flattening of the right nasolabial fold
key_facts: 66-year-old man
24-hour history of symptoms
History of hypertension
No history of neurological disorders
Alert and oriented
Effacement of the right frontal wrinkle
Incomplete closure of the right eyelid
Muscle strength in the right upper and lower extremities: grade 0/5
Hemorrhage in the left thalamus-radiation crown region and in the lateral ventricle on CT scan
Corticobulbar tract appeared thinner on the left side than on the right on diffusion tensor imaging

shortlist.label: Ischemic stroke
shortlist.why_kept: Acute onset of unilateral facial and limb weakness with impaired motor function

shortlist.label: Intracerebral hemorrhage
shortlist.why_kept: Hemorrhage in the left thalamus-radiation crown region and in the lateral ventricle on CT scan

shortlist.label: Cerebral vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Unilateral facial and limb weakness with impaired motor function, possible inflammation of blood vessels

shortlist.label: Arteriovenous malformation
shortlist.why_kept: Possible abnormal connection between arteries and veins, leading to hemorrhage

shortlist.label: Cavernous angioma
shortlist.why_kept: Possible vascular malformation, considering the patient's symptoms and imaging findings

raw.rationale: The emergency CT scan of the head showed hemorrhage in the left thalamus-radiation crown region and in the lateral ventricle, which directly supports the diagnosis of intracerebral hemorrhage.

rejected.label: Ischemic stroke
rejected.why: No evidence of ischemia on imaging studies

rejected.label: Cerebral vasculitis
rejected.why: No evidence of inflammation on imaging studies

rejected.label: Arteriovenous malformation
rejected.why: No evidence of abnormal blood vessel formation on imaging studies

rejected.label: Cavernous angioma
rejected.why: No evidence of abnormal blood vessel formation on imaging studies
